_how: How each public repository shows up in the profile. A new public repository appears on its own with its GitHub description; add it here to change the text or the order, or list it in 'hide'.

text.corvex-bench: An honest benchmark for security scanners and AI code auditors: 71 known flaws, clean twins for false alarms, SARIF and JSON scoring, regression baseline.
text.corvex-netkit: Network and vulnerability utilities written from public specs: read .pcap and .pcapng, generate captures with 21 common attacks, match installed versions to real CVEs, look up addresses in huge network lists.
text.ai-security-rules: Security rules for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, AGENTS.md): no leaked keys, no open Supabase or Firebase, no AI endpoints without limits. Ready-to-copy files plus a generator for your stack.
text.corvex-opensource: The open skills and tools of corvexai in one place: how to report findings with checkable quotes of the code, how to measure a scanner honestly, and the tools above.
